parameters.description: The code to run. Can be a file ID from within Shuffle.
parameters.name: code
parameters.value:
source_ip = "$extract_alert_data.all_fields.data.srcip"
allowlist = "$allowlisted_ips"

allowed = [ip.strip() for ip in allowlist.split(",") if ip.strip()]

print("true" if source_ip in allowed else "false")

actions.description: Run a command on remote machine with SSH
actions.label: Block_Source_IP
actions.name: run_ssh_command

parameters.description: A port on which SSH service is running
parameters.name: port

parameters.description: Password for SSH user. Use either password or private key.
parameters.name: password
command
parameters.value: sudo iptables -C INPUT -s $extract_alert_data.all_fields.data.srcip -j DROP 2>/dev/null || sudo iptables -A INPUT -s $extract_alert_data.all_fields.data.srcip -j DROP; sudo ufw deny from $extract_alert_data.all_fields.data.srcip to any || true; echo blocked:$extract_alert_data.all_fields.data.srcip
